title: EngramaBench: Evaluating Long-Term Conversational Memory with Structured Graph Retrieval
why_relevant: Introduces a long-term conversational memory benchmark with an adversarial abstention slice, tangentially relevant to abstention/calibration evaluation in retrieval-augmented assistants.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on conversational memory architectures, not robust RAG under noisy/adversarial/conflicting evidence; adversarial abstention is only a minor component.
